solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id, i.id,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY i.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM invoices i
JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id, amount_rank, i.id;
notes: DENSE_RANK per customer, ordered by amount descending. A correlated COUNT(DISTINCT amount) formulation returns the same 205 rows.
